envelope.description: Failure classifier module and retry constants

body.title: Failure classifier module and retry constants
body.summary: Add vscode-plugin/src/chat/chat-failure.ts (vscode-free, pure): classifyFailure(message): InfraCause with conservative patterns written from the messages cli-adapter.ts produces and the daemon's isTransientCliError (overloaded, rate limit, 429 and 5xx, timeouts, connection failures map to their causes; the not-authenticated text and the CLIs' unauthorised, invalid key and login-required texts map to auth; 'CLI not found' (ENOENT) and any unmatched text map to other; passing start-up failures such as EAGAIN map to spawn), plus the constants RETRY_DELAYS_MS = [10000, 60000, 300000] and MAX_INFRA_RETRIES = 3. Nothing calls it yet.
acceptanceChecks: overloaded, rate limit, 429 and 5xx, timeout and connection-failure texts map to their causes
the adapter's not-authenticated text and the CLIs' unauthorised and invalid key texts map to auth
CLI not found and any unmatched text, including a model refusal, map to other
the module imports nothing from vscode and does no I/O

tests.name: chat-failure.test.ts: overloaded, rate limit, 429 and 5xx texts, timeouts and connection failures map to their causes
chat-failure.test.ts: the adapter's not-authenticated text and the CLIs' unauthorised and invalid key texts map to auth
chat-failure.test.ts: CLI not found and any unmatched text, including a model refusal, map to other
